review: Chorus is verse 2 (five lines, label 1), C repeats all five joined by " · "; label القرار stays as data. 2:2 and 2:5 repeat verbatim in the Arabic. The prodigal-son register (father's embrace, return, "there is a place for me") is kept; 3:5 "عدت لنفسي" as שַׁבְתִּי אֶל־נַפְשִׁי. Glossary: חִבּוּקִים for أحضان, יָדִיד for المحبوب, סְלִיחָה for الغفران, כִּסּוּפִים/נִכְסַפְתִּי for تمنيت (glossary's yearning noun), נֶפֶשׁ for نفس. Short lines 1:4, 2:2-2:5 kept proportional to the Arabic.
